name: kerala
description: UNCALIBRATED starting guesses for Kerala (about 8 to 13 degrees north). Tropical cirrus and anvil outflow sit higher than mid-latitude cirrus, trade cumulus bases are low. The grazing_colours labels are rough guesses that need calibrating against real observations.

stages.name: golden_hour
stages.description: Low, warm, directional light. Over the Arabian Sea horizon this is a short window near the equator.

stages.name: sunset_glow
stages.description: Sun just set. Orange-red light still reaches low and mid clouds.

stages.name: afterglow
stages.description: High cloud stays lit here. Pink tends to arrive late in this stage, just before a cloud's own shadow time.

stages.name: purple_light
stages.description: Fading violet-pink; only the highest cloud toward the horizon is lit.

stages.name: blue_hour
stages.description: Deep blue sky, cloud colour mostly gone.
